name: Java
description: Core Java, JVM architecture, Collections Framework, Multithreading, and Garbage Collection.

questions.prompt: Why should you override `hashCode()` whenever you override `equals()` in a Java class?
options: To allow the JVM to serialize the object
To ensure equal objects produce identical hash codes when used in hash-based collections like HashMap
questions.explanation: The contract of hashCode states that if two objects are equal according to equals(), they must produce the same hashCode.

questions.prompt: Where are local primitive variables stored during method execution in Java?
questions.explanation: Local primitive variables and object reference variables are allocated directly on the thread’s call stack frame.
